sn3.25:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn3.25:1.3: handa kuto nu tvaṃ mahārāja āgacchasi divā divassāti?
sn3.25:1.4: yāni tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ paṭhavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ rājakaraṇīyāni santi, tesvāhaṃ etarahi ussukkaṃ āpannoti.
sn3.25:2.2: idha te puriso āgaccheyya puratthimāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko.
sn3.25:2.4: yagghe mahārāja jāneyyāsi: ahaṃ āgacchāmi puratthimāya disāya.
sn3.25:2.5: tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ. sabbe pāṇe nippoṭhento āgacchati.
sn3.25:2.6: yaṃ te mahārāja karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn3.25:2.7: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya dakkhiṇāya disāya …pe… atha tatiyo puriso āgaccheyya pacchimāya disāya …pe…
sn3.25:2.9: catuttho puriso āgaccheyya uttarāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko.
sn3.25:2.11: yagghe mahārāja jāneyyāsi: ahaṃ āgacchāmi uttarāya disāya.
sn3.25:2.12: tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ. sabbe pāṇe nippoṭhento āgacchati.
sn3.25:2.13: yaṃ te mahārāja karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn3.25:2.14: evarūpe te mahārāja mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyanti?
sn3.25:3.1: evarūpe me bhante mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyāti.
sn3.25:4.1: ārocemi kho te mahārāja, pativedayāmi kho te mahārāja, adhivattati kho taṃ mahārāja jarāmaraṇaṃ.
sn3.25:4.2: adhivattamāne ca te mahārāja, jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyanti?
sn3.25:4.3: adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāya.
sn3.25:4.4: yāni tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ paṭhavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ hatthiyuddhāni bhavanti.
sn3.25:4.5: tesampi bhante hatthiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
sn3.25:4.6: yānipi tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ …pe…
sn3.25:4.10: tesampi bhante pattiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
sn3.25:4.11: santi kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mahāmattā ye pahonti āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ.
sn3.25:4.12: tesampi bhante mantayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
sn3.25:4.13: saṃvijjati kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañceva vehāsaṭṭhañca. yena mayaṃ pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ.
sn3.25:4.14: tesampi bhante dhanayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
sn3.25:4.15: adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyāti.
sn3.25:5.2: adhivattamāne ca te jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyāti.
sn3.25:5.3: idamavoca bhagavā. idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca
